items.basis: Commerce Dept lifted the export/safety hold Jul 8; OpenAI confirmed broad public availability (API/ChatGPT/Codex) starting Jul 9. Sol/Terra/Luna all launch. Cleared and dated, not a market bet.

Multiple trackers and a Polymarket projection now target Jul 17 after Google scrapped the base model for a ground-up retrain (math, SVG, image, coding). Polymarket 'next Gemini Pro by Jul 31' 91%; the Jul 17 date specifically ~62%.

Polymarket 'GPT-6 released by Dec 31' holds at ~71% (Sep 30 window ~41%). GPT-5.5/5.6 absorbed features once teased for GPT-6, so the label likely needs a bigger product moment; conviction steady for a Q4 launch.
Musk has repeatedly teased Grok 5 for 2026; xAI shipping fast (Grok 4.3 in May) and just rebranded to SpaceXAI (Jul 6). No dated market.
Anthropic's Opus cadence has run ~6-10 weeks; Opus 4.8 shipped May 28, Sonnet 5 Jun 30. No dated market.
CEO Mensch confirmed a new open-weight model family entering early access in July 2026 with research/government/industry partners; no name, params, or benchmarks published yet.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as preview; no stable GA yet. DeepSeek historically follows a preview with a refresh.
